verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS communications platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack says RingCentral's source is published or openly licensed. The SDK listings (JavaScript, Java, .NET) say nothing about source availability or licensing, and client SDKs are not the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
